top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov on GLP-1) rewards the complete, independently confirmed discovery chain from proglucagon processing and the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide to glucose-dependent insulin secretion and extra-pancreatic actions, with mature randomised outcome evidence in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. A physiology-and-active-form citation keeps the trio and the wording consistent; Mojsov's contested priority and Habener's omission are real weaknesses but are still better handled here than by rewarding drug development. P002 is a serious second because Knudsen's long-acting analogue work needed genuine insight, but it centres on development inside a company and shifts the citation toward the therapy. No award is clearly worse given the maturity of the science.
